Relative script paths get denied, and the guard also refuses writes into the run folder from anywhere but `note.mjs`.

**Claude:** Duplicate of the finding I just routed to the hooks agent (pin to real absolute paths). Their suggestion to resolve against the tracked cwd matches my instruction to deny relative paths. Still waiting on two agents; I'll verify everything with real tests when they report.
